messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Some side effects were more common with particular conditions.
Sleepiness was more common in depression trials.
Insomnia and agitation were more common in OCD trials.
Constipation and agitation were more common in panic disorder trials.
Tiredness was more common in PTSD trials.
Insomnia, dizziness, tiredness, dry mouth, and a general feeling of being unwell were more common in social anxiety disorder trials.
In PMDD trials, sleepiness, dry mouth, dizziness, tiredness, and stomach pain were more common.
In these trials, 12% of people taking sertraline stopped treatment.
They stopped treatment because of a side effect.
This was compared with 4% of people taking placebo.
The most common reason for stopping was nausea (3%).
Diarrhea (2%) was another common reason for stopping.
Agitation (2%) was also a common reason for stopping.
Insomnia (2%) was a common reason for stopping.
Sexual side effects of sertraline:
SSRIs including sertraline can cause sexual problems.
In men, sexual problems can mean delayed ejaculation or being unable to ejaculate.
Triplet: ["sertraline", "has side effect more common in", "depression trials"]

The relation 'has side effect more common in' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug's specified side effect is more frequently observed in the condition or trial type specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect frequency': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity with the frequency indicated.
B. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'has side effect more likely in': The subject drug is more likely to cause the specified adverse effect or reaction in the population or group specified by the object entity.
D. 'improves': The subject drug enhances or positively affects the condition or parameter specified by the object entity.
E. 'has effect': The subject drug produces the effect specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
